options.content:
## 🎣 Fishing Score (0–10)
| Score | Color | Meaning |
|-------|-------|--------|
| 8–10 | 🔵 Blue | **EXCELLENT** — Prime time. Fish hard. |
| 6–7 | 🟢 Green | **GREAT** — Very active bite likely |
| 4–5 | 🟡 Yellow | **GOOD** — Worth the trip |
| 2–3 | 🟠 Orange | **FAIR** — Slow but possible |
| 0–1 | 🔴 Red | **SLOW** — Tough day, try later |

## 🌊 Solunar Periods
- **Major periods** (🟢 2-hour windows): Moon upper/lower transit — fish most active, biggest feeding windows
- **Minor periods** (🟡 1-hour windows): Moonrise/moonset — shorter activity burst

## 🌙 Moon Phase Tips
- **Full Moon / New Moon**: Strongest gravitational pull → best fishing overall
- **Quarter Moons**: Moderate activity
- **Tip**: Fish the 30 min before and after each tide change — the moving water activates predators

## 📡 Data Sources
- Tide predictions: [NOAA CO-OPS API](https://tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov) — real predictions, updated every 10 min
- Solunar windows: Computed from moon transit/rise/set using PyEphem
- Fishing score: Composite of moon phase, solunar proximity, tide change, and dawn/dusk bonus

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT datetime(logged_at,'unixepoch','localtime') AS Time, location AS Location, species AS Species, CASE caught WHEN 1 THEN '✅ Caught' ELSE '❌ Skunked' END AS Result, fish_count AS Count, size_in AS 'Size (in)', weight_lbs AS 'Wt (lb)', ROUND(pressure_mb,0)||' '||(CASE WHEN pressure_trend=1 THEN '↑' WHEN pressure_trend=-1 THEN '↓' ELSE '→' END) AS Pressure, solunar_period AS Solunar, ROUND(fishing_score,1) AS Score, notes AS Notes FROM fish_log ORDER BY logged_at DESC LIMIT 50
